heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated to departments or agencies of the Federal Government such sums as the Congress may determine to be necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 1243 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
